scope: Two live owned children on the same disposable APFS sparse image, tested in sequence on an ephemeral macOS CI runner; no production state

observed.entry_unmount_output: Volume OwnedMemoryBoundary on disk8s1 failed to unmount

interpretation: A live child that opened and closed the file without retaining an entry allowed normal unmount. A live child retaining a writable Mach memory entry was followed by normal-unmount refusal and a still-mounted volume; once that child exited, unmount succeeded. The contrast supports attribution to the retained entry on this owned image. A read-only reattach after detach found the changed file prefix.
limits: The command emitted a generic failure, not an errno or EBUSY reason. Sequential arms do not establish an if-and-only-if rule for all APFS states or every reference class. This cannot unmount the running guest system/Data volume and does not prove the guest no-writer hold, host boot gate, stopped-VM capture, four-history acceptance or resumption. The one-time CI invocation was removed after recording the result.
